name: csvql
description: Read-only SQL on CSV files for AI agents. No writes, no network, --root confines file access, and capped results keep large files out of context.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: The only folder the agent can read. Subfolders included.

tools.name: csv_query
tools.description: Run SQL against a CSV file; results are capped so large files never flood the context.

tools.name: csv_schema
tools.description: Column names, types, and row count for a CSV file.

tools.name: csv_list
tools.description: List CSV files in a directory and its subfolders (up to 200).
